stem: An analyst computes a TV line's sell-through as the units sold divided by the units on hand today. What is wrong with this?

options.text: Nothing is wrong, as long as returned units go back into the stock on hand
The denominator must be the units received this season, not today's stock
The numerator must be the stock on hand, since unsold units are the real risk
Units must be weighted by price, so that the dearer TV models count for more
